1. Turn off autoplay. Choose what you watch on purpose. Deciding what goes into your head is the first step to a sharper mind. Be the one who picks.
2. Take notes by hand. Writing with a pen forces you to summarise in your own words, and that's when real understanding happens. Try it this week.
3. Go for walks without headphones. Letting your mind wander is when it connects ideas. Many of your best thoughts arrive when you're not trying.
4. Learn the basics of a new skill every few months. A language, an instrument, a sport. New skills build new connections in your brain.
5. Feed your curiosity daily. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and small lessons every morning keep my mind awake.
slides.texte_sophia: 5. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Small lessons every morning keep my mind awake.

slides.texte_overlay: 6. Change your mind when the evidence changes. Smart people update their opinions. Holding on to a wrong idea out of pride is the opposite of intelligence.
7. Spend time in nature. A forest, a park, the sea. Time away from screens and noise restores your attention and makes thinking clearer.
